entry.name: ZoomMin
entry.label: Smallest zoom the overview reaches (1.0 is native scale).

entry.name: GridBase
entry.label: Minor grid spacing in canvas pixels.

entry.name: GridOctaveFactor
entry.label: Each coarser grid octave is this many times larger.

entry.name: TileImage
entry.label: Optional image tiled across the canvas at 1:1. Empty draws the grid.

entry.name: ToggleShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence that opens and closes the canvas.

entry.name: HomeShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence that returns to the canvas origin.

entry.name: DesktopGap
entry.label: Gap in canvas pixels between the frame groups of neighbouring virtual desktops when first laid out.

entry.name: FollowActivation
entry.label: Pan the canvas so an activated off-screen window comes on screen.

entry.name: PublishGround
entry.label: Write the ground offset to the kwin-canvas-ground wallpaper via plasmashell.

entry.name: AutoActivate
entry.label: Open the canvas as soon as the effect loads (nested test harness).

entry.name: DebugCommand
entry.label: Command executed on reconfigure when DebugSeq changes (nested test harness).
